Package viewModel

Class InventoryViewModel

java.lang.Object
viewModel.InventoryViewModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeListener, EventListener
public class InventoryViewModel extends Object implements PropertyChangeListener
ViewModel for the Inventory screen.

Handles loading ingredients from the model, tracking selection state, and updating ingredient stock values. Also listens for model updates and refreshes the view accordingly.
